summary.en: A Riyadh date palm (Phoenix dactylifera) from Boulevard City: a ringed trunk under a crown of 48 grey-green pinnate fronds that sway in the wind. Near, middle and far versions.
summary.ar: نخلة تمر رياضية من بوليفارد سيتي: جذع بحلقات تعلوه قمة من 48 سعفة رمادية خضراء تتمايل مع الريح، بثلاثة مستويات تفاصيل.

source.symbol: palmMaterials, loadPalm (palm_lod0, palm_lod1, palm_card); main.js buildPalms / placePalms

defaults.note: height: palm_lod0 at scale 1 (palm.report.json 10.47 m); the runtime scales each instance by height / 10.47 through its matrix, as Boulevard scales each mapped tree (0.85 + 0.35 r across, x (0.9 + 0.3 r) in height; 0.6 + 0.25 r for source-3 trees), and the collider with it. That jitter is per tree, not a default. No lean in Boulevard (planted palms stand upright). wind multiplies palm.js's rooted sway (0.16 m + 0.05 m at 10 m, growing with height squared) and leaflet flutter (0.05); lean and wind are per-instance values. frondTint white leaves palm.js's leaf colour as it is. draw follows main.js buildPalms / placePalms: Phone palm_lod1 within 50 m (PALM_R) then the card, no palm shadows; High palm_lod0 within 50 m (shadows), palm_lod1 to 160 m and the card beyond (no shadows); physical fronds only on High's palm_lod0, palm.js full(true) on the rest. Draws: 2 per LOD (trunk, fronds) where Boulevard has 1 (palm.js shares one material). One draw would need one material for both, branching on the baked kind as palm.js does, so one registry preset; the plan splits the look into two presets (palm-bark, palm-frond) so bark and fronds are adjusted apart, and 2 draws per LOD is inside the Phone budget (2), so the split is kept.

made_by: 3DPLAT (Blender 5.2 by script, models/palm/src/palm.py in Kr4T/3DPLAT; look in TSL, palm.js)
